svg.title: Enumeration versus variable elimination
svg.desc: Enumeration joins all factors into P(R,T,L) then sums out R and T. Variable elimination joins R, sums it out, then joins T and sums it out.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: Enumeration builds the full joint; VE interleaves join and sum
